name: Illustrious XL 2.0
desc: Danbooru-tag anime SDXL from OnomaAI. Widely used as a daily driver where Animagine is treated as the starter model. Downloaded to give the project a second house style - not to replace the first.
note: Community settings: CFG 4.5-7.5 with 5.5 the usual sweet spot, 28 steps, Euler A. Native 1536x1536 as well as 1024x1024. STATUS UNTESTED until it has been rendered side by side with Animagine on identical prompts and seeds - a recommendation is not a measurement. Changing checkpoint changes every face, so this is a per-film choice, never a mid-film one.
